title: Cylindrical doghouse
body_html:
Description: UFBemo, Newly Designed Cat Bed, Multifunctional Cat Bed.

Features: 1) All season cat bed, N in 1 pet bed which can be a deep sleeping bed, round cat bed, tent / cat house, cave and mat.

2) This deep bed is designed according to the nature of the cat as a hunter.

For cats, it is a safe bed that can be safely hidden while looking out.

3) Embossed faux leather fabric with soft plush interior fabric, making the bed elegant and warm, cats are sensitive, especially their paws. They do not like any long skin tissue because it is not stable and the paw feeling is not good. This faux leather fabric is soft, warm and has a good cat paw feel.

4) The whole bed is removable, to clean and wash. High-quality YKK zipper to ensure long-term use.

5) A bed for all functions, saving space and environmentally friendly.
